reason: pc-0070-g1 的 key_text "The IRB/IEC should retain all relevant records (e.g." 在括号导引处被截断，不是保留完整命中含义的最小逐字片段（丢失了 "in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements and make them available upon request from the regulatory authority(ies)" 这一约束，且以 "(e.g." 结尾不成句）；对应 evidence_span（char 818-870）同样只是条款 1.5.1 的前半句，不构成完整条款。pc-0070-g2 的 evidence_span（char 871-1020）以逗号起始、以 ")" 结束，也只是同一句的后半段。两个 gold 单元实为页文本中同一句 1.5.1 "The IRB/IEC should retain all relevant records (e.g. , documented procedures, membership lists, lists of occupations/affiliations of members, submitted documents, minutes of meetings and correspondence) in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements and make them available upon request from the regulatory authority(ies)." 的机械切分，落在不同物理偏移不等于语义上缺一不可，g1 相对 g2 属冗余单元。
suggestion: 合并为单一 gold：evidence_span 取条款 1.5.1 完整句（自 "The IRB/IEC should retain all relevant records" 至 "regulatory authority(ies)."），key_text 取 "documented procedures, membership lists, lists of occupations/affiliations of members, submitted documents, minutes of meetings and correspondence"（页内唯一，且保留了所问"例子"的对象含义），删除 pc-0070-g1。
